_comment: Import template for your own EM Study content. Import this file via Settings > Your content in the app. You may include 'questions', 'flashcards', or both. 'domain' must be one of the topic ids below. Fields marked optional can be omitted; ids are generated if omitted. 'source' is shown under the explanation.

questions.stem: Your clinical vignette / question stem goes here.
questions.rationale: Explain why the correct answer is right (and ideally why the others are wrong).
questions.source: Optional citation, e.g. the guideline and year

flashcards.front: Prompt / question side of the card.
